Subject: Workshop agenda — 2-day executive session (May 11-12)

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. We confirmed May 11-12 for the on-site exec workshop in SF. Can your team help lock the detailed agenda and who will own each slot? Key asks from our side:

- A short (20–25m) product roadmap / prioritization talk for the senior execs (day 1 morning)
- A technical security Q&A (45m) for engineering and InfoSec on day 1 afternoon
- Breakout sessions on day 2 (3 concurrent tracks) — each needs a facilitator and a 3-page pre-read for attendees

We have internal stakeholders (CEO, Head of Eng, Head of Sales) who want the pre-reads no later than May 3 so they can circulate. Would you send a proposed slot matrix and indicate who from Redwood will be the deck owners and pre-read leads?

Also: small ask — Propulsion will provide a ~5-minute customer case study slot on day 2; we’ll need AV and a clicker.

Best,
Ellen

1) Slot matrix (attachment): Marissa will draft the initial slot matrix with timings + proposed owners.
2) Deck owners: Laura will pick up technical/security materials and the FAQ appendix. Ben will coordinate the product roadmap deck + speaker notes.
3) Pre-read bundles: I’ll act as pre-read editor — we’ll create three 3-page pre-read packs for each breakout track and one 2-page exec brief.
4) Logistics: Marissa will confirm AV needs (clicker, lapel mic) for the Propulsion case study slot.
5) Dry run: propose May 7 for a 60-minute dry run with all presenters.

Attachments I’ll drop shortly: slot_matrix_v1.xlsx and preread_index.md.
